CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1982
CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1982
PRESIDENT S ORDER 2 OF 1982
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th February, 1982]
No. F.
l7(2)/82 Pub.
The following Order made by the President is hereby
published for general information:-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977(C.M.L.A. Order
No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the
President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and commencement.-
(1) This Order may be called the Constitution
(Amendment) Order, 1982.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment of Article 181 of the Constitution.
In the Constitution, in Article 181, in clause (1), the following explanation
shall be added at the end, namely:-
Explanation.- In this
clause, Judge of a High Court includes a person who has retired as a judge of
a High Court.
